author: Stahly
description:
After decades in the shadows of Aeldari lore, the nomadic Exodites finally thunder onto the tabletop astride their fantastical Drakesteeds. In this review, we're unboxing Kill Team: Exodite, taking a close look at the Dragon Masters kill team and their Beast Snagga opponents, flipping through the lavish new hardcover Dossier, and breaking down every build option the sprues have to offer. High-res sprue images and the full unboxing video are included below, so read on for everything you need to know before this maiden world showdown hits shelves.

The post Kill Team: Exodite review: Space Elves on dinosaurs, at last appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Kill Team: Exodite review: Space Elves on dinosaurs, at last
